description.en: Run one instruction on every online Windows and macOS machine, across networks and regions: a dependency-free relay talks to each machine over outbound connections only (Tailscale, a public VPS behind TLS, or a tunnel), every machine runs the command in its own checkout, and results come back with a commit, a working-tree fingerprint and a command hash so an environment mismatch is reported as unverifiable instead of being mistaken for a different result. Sending work needs its own operator token, separate from the per-machine device token.
description.zh: 一条指令同时下发给所有在线的 Windows 与 macOS 机器，可跨网络跨区域：零依赖中继只通过出站连接与各机通信（Tailscale 内网、公网 VPS + TLS、或隧道），各机在各自的项目副本上执行，结果连同 commit、工作区指纹与命令哈希一并回传，因此"环境不一致"会被判为 unverifiable，而不会被误当成结果分歧。下发指令需要独立于设备令牌的 operator token。

description.zh: 通过 Telegram 驱动 dsh Agent：每个项目目录一个话题、语音与图片输入、按话题顺序执行的任务队列、每个话题的目标与任务清单、会话分支与切换、实时进度消息、中英俄三语命令菜单，以及模型、插件、会话与日志的管理命令。可搜索插件市场、安装前查看插件卡片、一键更新全部插件。需要 Telegram bot token，并把数字用户 id 填进 allowedUserIds。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle registering one skill that turns long-form production (academic papers, industry analysis, business commentary) into a 9-role pipeline: T1 literature / T2 data / T3 case scouts running in parallel, T4 analyst, T5 writer, T6 critical companion, T7 auditor, T8 finalizer run by the coordinator, T9 peer reviewer — across 6 phases with triangular evidence verification, a 26-check M-gate (25 scripted checks plus one human checkpoint), a G0-G16 audit including a Chinese AI-trace gate, peer-review scoring with journal matching, and 4 human checkpoints. Installs with `dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` (package.json#dsh.bundle.patch plus a lib/index.js entry that registers the skill); ships role cards for T1-T9, templates and 36 zero-dependency verification scripts, with five-language READMEs.
description.zh: DSH bundle 技能包：把深度长文生产（学术论文 / 行业分析 / 商业评论）拆成 9 角色流水线——T1 文献 / T2 数据 / T3 案例三线并行检索、T4 分析、T5 写作、T6 批判伙伴、T7 审计、T8 终检（主控亲执行）、T9 同行评审，跨 6 个阶段，含三角验证、M 门 26 项终检（25 项机检 + 1 项人工）、G0-G16 独立审计（含中文 AI 痕迹闸）、审稿评分与期刊匹配，以及 4 个人在环节点。以 bundle 分发（`package.json#dsh.bundle.patch` + `lib/index.js` 入口注册技能），`dsh plugin add lunheng-article-pipeline` 即装；随包 T1-T9 角色卡、模板与 36 个零依赖校验脚本，README 五语。

description.en: Interactive UI components rendered inline in replies: layout, charts, forms, quizzes, mermaid, 3D scenes, and an action event loop back to the model.
description.zh: 助手回复内渲染交互式 UI 组件：布局、图表、表单、测验、mermaid、3D 场景与回传事件循环。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to IM platforms like WeChat, DingTalk, QQ, and Feishu for seamless messaging.
description.zh: DSH IM Connect 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的IM链接插件，无缝链接微信、企业微信、钉钉、QQ、飞书等

description.en: Adds /review, /review-status, and /review-cancel to spawn an independent native subagent that inspects a chosen Git scope (base branch, uncommitted changes, a commit, or custom instructions) and returns a findings report in the current conversation, with English or Chinese output from the host locale.
description.zh: 提供 /review、/review-status 和 /review-cancel，用独立原生子 Agent 审查所选 Git 范围（基准分支、未提交更改、某次提交或自定义要求），并把发现报告返回当前会话；报告语言跟随宿主 locale，支持中英文。

description.en: Presentation skill and tools: one sentence or one document to an HTML slideshow plus editable PPTX, seven layouts (incl. quote and native PPTX tables), speaker notes (HTML S-key panel and native notes slides), five built-in themes, default theme/language config and bilingual support. A step-by-step first-run guide (4 steps) now opens inside its settings panel.
description.zh: 演示文稿技能与工具：一句话或一篇文档生成 HTML 放映与可编辑 PPTX，7 种页型（含金句与原生 PPTX 表格），演讲者备注（HTML 按 S 呼出 + PPTX 原生备注页），内置 5 套主题，可配置默认主题/语言，中英双语。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.en: Provides lightweight context management to keep essential memory active without heavy overhead.
description.zh: 提供轻量级上下文管理，保持关键记忆活跃且不增加过多负担。

description.en: Folia 壁纸引擎：把本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸搬进 DSH 界面（场景实时渲染 / 视频 / 网页），内置液态玻璃与 Folia 吉祥物，并可从自建站点拉取壁纸。单包形态（组件已合并）。
Task ledger board for dsh (DeepSeek Harness): read-only board over task-ledger skill workspaces. The task-ledger skill is bundled — install the plugin, get the skill globally.
Scopes memory capture to specific projects or sessions, enabling targeted and organized long-term recall.
description.zh: 将记忆捕获限定在特定项目或会话内，实现精准且有组织的长期回顾。

description.en: Automatically captures and stores runtime context and project documents for persistent, searchable memory across sessions.
description.zh: 自动捕获运行时上下文和项目文档，实现跨会话的持久化、可搜索记忆。

description.en: Web search bridge for text-only agents: ask the web or X, get structured JSON evidence (search, fetch, citations).
description.zh: 纯文本 agent 的联网搜索桥：搜索网页与 X，返回结构化 JSON 证据（search/fetch/引用）。

description.en: Bottom info bar for the DSH Web UI: provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and real persisted per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DSH 底部信息栏：一行显示服务商/模型、真实余额、高峰(琥珀)/空闲(绿)价与倒计时，以及本对话·今日·近一月·全部花费（真实落盘统计）。

description.en: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中以会话级 artifact 安全展示交互式 HTML 可视化。

Static capability disclosure for DeepSeek Harness plugins: a Settings page and CLI that list installed plugins' capabilities, literal destinations, install scripts, and injection shapes (prompt registrations, shipped skill text, bundle patch), each with file:line evidence. Code-determined, reproducible, zero-token. Disclosure only — not a security verdict, never a safety claim.
description.zh: DSH 插件静态能力披露：设置页与 CLI 列出已装插件的权限能力、字面量去向、安装脚本与注入形态（prompt 注册、自带 skill 文本、bundle patch），每条附文件:行号证据。代码判定、可复现、零 token。只做披露，不做安全承诺，不判定恶意。

description.en: All-in-one local memory: JSONL files per scope (session, project, global, or a custom name) with per-scope dedup, five model tools (memory_save, memory_search, memory_list, memory_get, memory_forget), automatic recall and hard rules injected into the agent pre-step, and a settings panel. Retrieval combines lexical IDF with a local embedding backend, which the panel can install and manage itself.
description.zh: 一体化本地记忆：按作用域（会话、项目、全局或自定义名）各一个 JSONL 文件、作用域内按内容去重，五个模型工具（memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_get / memory_forget），自动召回与硬性规则注入 agent 的 pre-step，并带一个设置面板。检索是词法 IDF 与本地向量后端的组合，向量后端可由面板一键安装并托管。

description.en: Same-origin in mechanism with the two loudest lines in context compression. The code-skeleton gate follows the skeletonization approach of Headroom (Apache-2.0), whose published headline is 20% fewer tokens for coding agents and 60–95% fewer tokens for JSON, same answers. The estimator channel follows TokenPilot (arXiv:2606.17016), which reports up to 60% lower cost for long-session agents. Both figures are theirs, quoted as-is; this plugin ships no benchmark of its own and claims no reduction of its own. What it adds for DeepSeek Harness: choose a compression profile, set the Auto Compact trigger level and toggle code-skeleton compression from one settings section, with exact DeepSeek V4 tokenizer measurement, same-revision count verification, and fail-open behaviour that keeps the original tool results on unsupported models. Within a turn it supports skeletonized information compression with a low original-text retrieval rate; at the tail of a turn it supports a turn-tail intent summary implemented purely by content substitution; context content stays safe, and the whole process runs inside the official JSONL compression.
description.zh: 机制上与上下文压缩领域最响的两条公开路线同源：代码骨架闸门沿用 Headroom（Apache-2.0）的骨架化思路，其公开头条为「编程 agent 少 20% token、JSON 载荷少 60–95% token，答案不变」；估计器通道沿用 TokenPilot（arXiv:2606.17016）的缓存感知上下文管理思路，该论文报告长会话 agent 成本最高降低 60%。这两个数字都是来源方自己的口径，此处照引；本插件不自带 benchmark，不自称任何降幅。在此之上为 DeepSeek Harness 提供：在同一设置区选择压缩 Profile、调整 Auto Compact 触发水位并开关代码骨架压缩；基于 DeepSeek V4 官方 tokenizer 的精确计量与同修订计数校验；非支持模型自动 fail-open，保留原始工具结果。回合内支持骨架化信息压缩、低原文取回率；turn 尾部支持尾部意图摘要（turn-tail intent summary）且仅以内容替代方式实现；上下文内容安全，全程在官方 jsonl 压缩内。

description.en: DFY DSH 对话外观设置：调节回复行距与过程行距，并扩展本地文件的打开方式。
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。

Shipped with cc-safety-net-style mechanical safety-net rules appended; supports both no-model and model-assisted security review, in modes such as 自动审查 (auto-review) and 机械直通 (mechanical pass-through). P0–P4 deterministic-first permission gate with permissive tier, learning sedimentation and approval-history UI; hard-deny credentials and protected paths, auto-allow internal read-only tools.
description.zh: 已追加 cc-safety-net 风格的机械安全网规则，同时支持无模型、有模型辅助方式的安全审查，模式为自动审查、机械直通等。P0–P4 确定性优先权限门控，含 Permissive 档位、学习沉淀与审批历史 UI；凭据/受保护路径硬拒绝，内部只读工具自动放行。

description.en: Adds a /simplify command that asks the agent to simplify code within a selected Git change scope, including staged changes, commits, and untracked files.
description.zh: 提供 /simplify 命令，让 Agent 在选定的 Git 变更范围内简化代码，支持暂存变更、提交及未跟踪文件。

description.en: Framework-upgrade safety and plugin gating for DSH: a pre-upgrade session-format contract preflight that adapts incompatible plugins and agent presets before you upgrade, automatic rollback on failure, auto-quarantine of plugins that broke a boot, plus environment fingerprinting and a public contract-rule pack. The built-in multi-source marketplace is a discovery layer only.
description.zh: DSH 框架升级安全与插件升级门控：升级前跑「会话格式契约预检」（把不兼容的插件与 agent 预设扫出来先适配）、升级失败自动回滚、把拖垮过启动的插件自动隔离；另有环境指纹与公开契约规则库持续守门。内置多源插件市场只作发现层。

description.en: Sidebar billing dashboard: real usage aggregated from session logs (per-model and per-day calls/tokens/cache), cost estimated in CNY from a current multi-provider pricing catalog, subscription-plan (coding/token/agent) routes exempt, and per-provider health dots.
description.zh: 侧边栏计费仪表盘：从会话日志聚合真实用量（按模型/按日统计调用、Token、缓存），按最新多厂商官方价格估算人民币费用，订阅套餐（coding/token/agent）通道豁免计费，并带各厂商健康状态圆点。

description.en: Adaptive reasoning slider skin that maps each model's available reasoning efforts onto a 0–30 visual intensity scale, with synchronized portraits, background, and interface colors.
description.zh: 自适应推理等级滑块皮肤，将当前模型可用档位映射到 0–30 视觉强度，并同步人物、背景和界面配色。

description.en: Manage the DeepSeek Harness skill catalog from Settings: list what DSH actually resolves, enable or disable a skill by policy without touching its source file, read and edit SKILL.md, and create, import, or permanently delete skills.
Nothing stays in the system prompt: a hit returns titles only, a body loads only when read, and project rules can grow themselves.
description.zh: 让东坡肉滚出系统提示：记忆不常驻，命中只给标题，正文读了才进上下文，项目规范还能自己长。

description.en: Bridges QQ into DeepSeek Harness over OneBot 11: private and group chats, on-device voice-to-text, image support, and ten interaction tools (poke, react, like, image, file, recall and more). Needs an OneBot 11 implementation such as NapCat running alongside.
description.zh: 把 QQ 接进 DeepSeek Harness：私聊群聊、本地语音转文字、看图，以及十个互动工具（戳一戳、贴表情、点赞、发图、发文件、撤回等）。需要本机另跑一个 OneBot 11 实现（如 NapCat）。

description.en: Right-click any attachment or path in the transcript and hand it to your own action: send it to a WeChat contact, open it in Chrome, or anything else you configure — one right-click, anything you want. Ships with quote-into-composer, reveal in the OS file manager, copy path and Send to…, and lets you add your own entries (command, open with, shortcut, link, PowerShell). Menus are drawn in the app's own style, never the system one.
description.zh: 对话里的附件和路径，右键就是你自己的入口：发给微信好友、用谷歌浏览器打开，或者你想到的任何处理——一个右键，做你想做的任何事。开箱带引用回输入框、在文件管理器里定位、复制路径、发送到…，再往下自己加一条入口（命令、打开方式、快捷指令、链接、PowerShell）。菜单跟着 App 的深浅色和圆角走，不是系统弹窗。

description.en: A draggable Live2D desktop pet for the DSH web GUI that tracks the pointer, changes motion, expression and outfit with the session phase, and opens a right-click control panel.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标，跟着会话状态换动作、表情与装扮，右键呼出控制面板。

description.en: Deep View: interactive views (charts, tables, inputs, answers) in any DeepSeek Harness chat

Three-tier now/next/later input planning dock for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI: a red/yellow/green priority strip replaces the busy-Enter queue, plain Enter queues to later, with in-place multi-line editing, drag reorder, and session-isolated freeze/resume; the freeze button bridges a separate plugin, [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard) (installable from dsh-market), via stopNextTurn/resume RPC + composer lock for a real per-session lock, pairing with its global peak-hour auto-pause to stop sessions during DeepSeek's high-cost windows and resume off-peak.
description.zh: 三档（now/next/later）输入规划 dock：以红/黄/绿色优先级条取代忙碌 Enter 排队栏，普通 Enter 排入 later，支持多行原位编辑、拖拽排序与会话级冻结/恢复；冻结按钮经 stopNextTurn/resume RPC + 输入框锁定，桥接另一独立插件 [dsh-session-guard](https://github.com/drscrewdriver/dsh-session-guard)（可在 dsh-market 安装）实现按会话真实冻结锁定，并配合其高峰全局自动暂停，在 DeepSeek 高价时段停止会话、错峰自动恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.

Shows a card in the sidebar footer with the DeepSeek account balance (read from the official /user/balance endpoint with the API key DSH already stores) and the unit prices of the active model — input, cache read and output — taken from a built-in snapshot of the official price table. A dot marks the current billing window and a countdown shows the time left until it flips: peak is Mon–Fri 9:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00 Beijing Time, excluding Chinese public holidays, and everything else is off-peak. Prices and the dot appear only for official DeepSeek models; for any other model the card shows the balance alone. The card refreshes every 30 seconds, on click, and when the model changes, and follows the app theme and the DSH language.
description.zh: 在侧边栏底部显示一张卡片：DeepSeek 账号余额（用 DSH 已保存的 API Key 调官方 /user/balance 接口获取），以及当前模型的档单价——输入、缓存读取、输出——取自内置的官方价格表快照。一个圆点标出当前计费时段，旁边是距离切换的倒计时：高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00（不含中国法定节假日），其余为空闲时段。档单价与圆点只对 DeepSeek 官方模型显示，其他模型只显示余额。卡片每 30 秒刷新一次，点击或切换模型时立即刷新，并跟随应用主题与 DSH 语言。

description.en: 将 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 包含的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，零配置使用。Bring the models in the WorkBuddy desktop app into DeepSeek Harness with zero configuration.
description.zh: 零配置地将 WorkBuddy 桌面应用中的模型自动接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Peak-hour auto session gate: weekend mode + global peak auto-pause + session-level freeze/resume + backend auto-retry, auto-resume on off-peak.
description.zh: 高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停（全局）+ 会话级冻结/恢复 + 后端自动重试；错峰自动续跑。

description.en: Sidebar session search that builds its own index instead of reusing DSH's full-text one: title to content toggle in one entry, results grouped per session with the strongest snippet and user/reply/tool tags, plus watermark-based incremental sync, archive-driven pruning of archived sessions, and a shadow rebuild that never blocks the live index.
description.zh: 自带独立索引的侧边栏会话搜索（不再复用 DSH 官方全文索引）：一处入口在标题与内容检索间切换，结果按会话聚合，附最强命中片段与 用户/回复/工具 类型标签；水位驱动增量同步、按归档集合清理已归档会话，整理走影子索引不阻塞在用索引。

description.en: Windows plugin that swaps the host shell executor for Git for Windows bash across every agent mode, materializes Git Bash variants of the standard, minimal, PTC and Cordis presets (per-file sha256-marked, user edits preserved), and exposes a gitBash capability so companion presets pick Git Bash automatically; when dsh-better-sidebar is installed it also adopts that sidebar's terminal shell (UI tabs and the model-facing terminal_* tools) through its official settings seam.
description.zh: Windows 插件：将宿主 shell 执行器换成 Git for Windows bash（全部 Agent 模式生效），并物化标准/极简/PTC/创造四个 Git Bash 预设变体（逐文件 sha256 标记、用户修改保留）；发布 gitBash 能力服务，让配套预设自动选用 Git Bash；若装有 dsh-better-sidebar，还会通过对方官方设置补丁口把其终端（UI 标签与模型 terminal_* 工具）一并切到 Git Bash。

description.en: Workspace-safe Office tools for agents: create/read Word, create/read/update Excel, and create/read PowerPoint decks with PNG/JPG/GIF image placement.
description.zh: 面向 agent 的工作区安全 Office 工具集：创建/读取 Word、创建/读取/更新 Excel、创建/读取 PowerPoint，并支持 PNG/JPG/GIF 图片排版。

description.en: Connects MCP servers, discovers tools and prompts, and manages connections with OAuth, API keys, and JSON import.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 通用 MCP连接器、连接管理与扩展市场：连接 MCP Server，发现工具与 Prompt，扩展 AI 技能；支持 OAuth/PKCE、API Key、JSON 导入。由企查查（Qichacha/QCC）团队发起维护。General-purpose MCP connector, connection manager, plugin, extension and integration marketplace.

description.en: One-click polish, expand and autopilot for the DeepSeek Harness composer: rewrite the draft with the model the session is switched to, expand a one-line wish into a task brief without asking questions, or let an AI drive a goal round after round.
description.zh: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一键润色、扩写和自动驾驶，写东西更省心。

description.en: JetBrains-style Git tool window for the sidebar: branch tree with ahead/behind badges, commit graph with text/author/date/path filters, per-file line diff, changes list and commit box, plus branch, tag and stash actions, merge, rebase, cherry-pick, reset and fetch/pull/push.
description.zh: 侧边栏里的 JetBrains 风格 Git 工具窗口：带 ahead/behind 角标的分支树、可按文本/作者/日期/路径筛选的提交图谱、逐文件行级 diff、变更列表与提交框，以及分支、标签、贮藏操作和合并、变基、优选、重置、抓取/拉取/推送。

description.en: Shows subscription quota and account balance beside the DeepSeek Harness model selector for 28 provider entries, with a shared settings page and a read-only quota tool.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型选择器旁显示 28 条提供商入口的订阅额度与账户余额，附统一设置页和只读额度查询工具。

description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio and streamable-http): four-level fail-closed authorization, mcpServers JSON import that rejects malformed args, credential redaction at every output boundary, an agent bridge that returns an honest review verdict instead of a fake approval, and a /mcp-reg operator console plus a settings page.
description.zh: MCP 连接器（stdio / streamable-http）的受治理注册表：四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers JSON 导入对畸形 args 大声报错、输出边界全程脱敏、agent 桥接返回诚实 review 而非伪装放行，配 /mcp-reg 操作台与设置页。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start, context-window guards, pure files.
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Turn any DSH selection into a reviewable quote — chat, file preview, terminal and diff; code quotes carry path#line. A sent quote keeps a source highlight and ordinal and jumps back, then joins a searchable review list with status, tags, multi-select insert, and Markdown/JSON export. Quotes collect above the composer as a 引用 ×N bar with per-chip edit and remove; side threads can bring their conclusion back to the main draft; a sent quote can be revised, with the old capsule marked superseded; replies can answer each quote by number.
description.zh: 把 DSH 里的任意选区变成可审阅的引用对象：正文、文件预览、终端、diff 都能引，代码引用带 path#line。发送后原句留下高亮与序号、可跳回；输入框上方「引用 ×N」可逐条编辑或移除；右侧栏引用清单可搜索、按状态与标签审阅、多选插入、导出 Markdown/JSON；侧边线程的结论可回流主会话；已发送的引用能追加修订，旧胶囊标「已修订」；模型可按「引用N」逐条回应。

description.en: Preflight for plugin authors: the checks the market runs — root export, dsh.client against exports\["./client"], whether npm pack ships the panel — on any folder or GitHub repo, from a panel or one command; plus release tooling and a Node testkit for client bundles.
description.zh: 给插件作者的安装前体检：把市场那套检查——根导出、dsh.client 与 exports\["./client"] 是否一致、npm pack 有没有带上面板——跑到任意文件夹或 GitHub 仓库上，面板里能点，命令行也能跑；另有发版工具，以及能在 Node 里挂起 client bundle 的 testkit。

description.en: VSCode-style editing experience for DeepSeek Harness: a Monaco-based central file editor (tabs, Ctrl+P quick open, status bar) and interactive diff review of agent edit/write results with per-change Keep/Undo, rollback and archiving, persisted across restarts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供类 VSCode 编码体验：基于 Monaco 的中央文件编辑器（文件页签、Ctrl+P 快速打开、状态栏），并对 Agent 的 edit/write 结果进行交互式差异审查（逐处采纳/拒绝、回滚、归档），状态跨重启持久化。

description.en: Shared real browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供共享的真实浏览器控制工具。

description.en: Newmark Core for DeepSeek Harness：MemoryLab、ComputerUse、Agent API、NewMate 陪伴内核与 heartBeat 重启投递，五个独立开关，共用 ~/.Newmark 用户库。

Windows only: the agent edits documents inside the Word, Excel and PowerPoint (Microsoft Office or WPS Office) windows you have open, through the applications' automation interface, so changes appear live and you can edit alongside; it reads structure, applies batches of edits, renders pages to images to check layout, and saves or exports PDF.
description.zh: 仅 Windows：Agent 通过办公软件的自动化接口，直接在你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint（微软 Office 或 WPS Office）窗口里改文档，改动实时出现，你可以同时编辑；可读取结构、批量修改、把页面渲染成图片核对排版、保存或导出 PDF。

description.en: Adds an AIignore tab to the right sidebar: scores the open conversation and its folder across five dimensions, blocks reads of build output, lockfiles and logs before they reach the model, and writes the .aiignore rules for them one button at a time.
description.zh: 在右侧栏新增 AIignore 标签页：按五个维度给当前对话和所在目录打分，在构建产物、锁文件、日志被读进模型之前把它们拦下，并能一键把这些规则写进 .aiignore。

description.en: ⚠️ Internal beta, do not download ⚠️ iLife: one DSH settings card for the iLife home-life suite — memo, calorie, chef, home, schedule and bill in a tab bar — covering every part of your home life.
description.zh: ⚠️内测中勿下载⚠️爱生活-覆盖你居家生活的方方面面。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated failures freeze, one-click safe mode, sidebar diagnostics panel (npm: `dsh-my-guardian`).
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: 自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。
One header button stops running turns, goals and background jobs and writes the plan to disk; after a restart the same button picks the work up again.
description.zh: 会话头一个按钮停掉回合、目标和后台任务，写盘；重启后同一个按钮把工作接回来。

description.en: Ten video tools (probe/cut/concat/encode/subtitle/extract/gif/frames/adjust/health) on the official subprocess service: probe summaries, batch frame extraction, speed/volume/mute/rotate adjust, shell-free argv, zero runtime dependencies.
description.zh: 视频处理十工具（探测/剪辑/拼接/转码/字幕烧录/抽帧/批量抽帧/GIF/调整/健康自检）：探测摘要、变速/音量/静音/旋转调整、官方 subprocess 服务、argv 无 shell 注入、零运行时依赖。

description.en: Git and SVN change preview with confirmed safe local Git branch switching for DSH
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: 自动修复客户端引起的请求失败，并让版本不匹配的 DSH 插件能装上、能跑起来。
DeepSeek Harness plugin: in-place conversation rewind in the same session window (Claude Code /rewind semantics) + optional file restore
description.zh: 在会话窗口内原地回退对话，并可选择恢复文件到先前状态。

description.en: Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 里直接搜索、浏览 dshbase 插件库，获取 1100+ 社区插件的安装命令，不用离开会话。

description.en: A dsh-better-sidebar tab that renders a session brief — a todo board read from the `todos` projection plus a deliverables section listing the files written this turn — and hides the official todo panel above the composer while it is mounted.
description.zh: dsh-better-sidebar 扩展：把会话简报渲染成右侧栏「概要」tab——来自 `todos` 投影的进展看板，加上回合内产物列表——并在挂载期间遮蔽 composer 上方的官方 todo 面板。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 插件：在对话中搜索、安装和管理 SkillHub 技能

Host-level proactive wake-ups for DeepSeek Harness: the model schedules its own alarms (once, recurring interval, or cron, with optional random jitter), cold sessions are woken on time by session resume, model-initiated follow-ups are gated by quiet hours and a daily delivery budget, silent wake turns end with proactive_reclaim and fold out of model context as tombstones, declared schedule files glob-sync JSON schedules into host alarms idempotently, min_idle_seconds defers wakes until the destination session quiets down, and a web panel (settings section plus per-session tab, SSE live refresh) manages alarms and wake history — the heartbeat engine for AI companions and roleplay characters with their own daily routines and world evolution.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 host 级主动唤醒：模型用 proactive_set 给自己设定闹钟（单次 / 循环间隔 / cron，支持 jitter 随机抖动），到点自动唤醒冷会话执行心跳、定时提醒与任务跟进；安静时段与每日投递预算约束模型自主跟进，静默唤醒以 proactive_reclaim 收尾并把唤醒上下文折叠为墓碑；声明式闹钟文件把 JSON 时间表幂等同步成 host 闹钟，min_idle_seconds 静默门让唤醒等会话空闲；自带 Web 管理面板（设置页节 + 会话页签，SSE 实时刷新）管理闹钟与唤醒历史——适合驱动 AI 陪伴、角色扮演（酒馆式人设）与 living agent 的心跳、日常安排和世界演算。

description.en: ChatGPT account sign-in for DeepSeek Harness through a Codex browser OAuth flow with no API key and no workspace selection: subscribes the login to pi-ai's Codex provider, lets you set the global default Codex model and reasoning effort for new sessions, refreshes the model list from the signed-in account's own catalog endpoint, and shows the five-hour and weekly usage windows in the composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 ChatGPT 账号登录：走 Codex 浏览器 OAuth，无需 API Key、无需选择工作空间；把登录结果接到 pi-ai 的 Codex provider，可设置新会话默认的 Codex 模型与思考强度，并按账号自己的目录接口刷新模型列表，在输入区展示 5 小时与每周用量窗口。

description.en: Scheduled cron tasks, background automation and agent execution for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供定时任务、后台自动化与 Agent 执行。

description.en: Sidebar session management for DeepSeek Harness: workspace groups sorted by latest activity, stale history folded, a global pinned section, follow-up marks, session delete into a recoverable trash, archived sessions managed from that same trash panel, per
description.zh: DSH 侧栏会话管理：工作区分组按最近活跃排序，过期历史折叠成一个「展开历史」控件，所有置顶会话汇总到顶部置顶区，运行中/未读/需跟进三色标记，删除会话移入可恢复的回收站（面板同时管理已归档会话），按工具拆分、参数与结果分开的 token 消耗统计，把会话移动到另一个工作区，以及一键把游离会话重新挂回工作区。

description.en: fnOS 飞牛 NAS integration for DeepSeek Harness, working through the fnOS browser SDK when the Web UI runs inside an fnOS app frame: follows the NAS theme while DSH is set to system preference, lists and revokes authorized NAS directory grants in Settings, opens files and links in the matching fnOS app, and syncs the DSH page title to the fnOS app window. Install from npm with `dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接进飞牛 fnOS：DSH 界面跑在 fnOS 应用框架里时通过 fnOS 浏览器 SDK 工作——DSH 设为跟随系统时读取并跟随 NAS 主题，在设置里列出和取消已授权的 NAS 目录，把文件与链接交给对应的 fnOS 应用打开，并把 DSH 页面标题同步到 fnOS 应用窗口。npm 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @tnnevol/dsh-fnos`。

description.en: OneBot v11 hub: sits between an upstream OneBot implementation (LLOneBot and similar) and downstream bot implementations, relaying events and actions verbatim, and gives the agent a per-session timeline, an action ledger, layered memory (active topics and tasks, long-term events, person and group profiles) and onebot_* tools for replying, media, members and raw API calls.
description.zh: OneBot v11 枢纽：夹在上游 OneBot 实现（LLOneBot 等）与下游 bot 实现之间，逐字转发事件与动作；给 agent 一条按会话的时间线、动作账本、分层记忆（进行中的话题与任务、长期事件、人物与群档案）以及一组 onebot_* 工具（回复、媒体、成员、原始 API 调用）。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for the DSH web GUI: shell prompt history (↑/↓, prefix search, Ctrl+R), Codex-style completion and next-prompt prediction (Tab or → to accept), selection toolbar (copy / quote / ask in side chat), right-click paste, draggable chat TOC, and a parallel side-chat thread in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 输入框提供终端式体验：↑/↓ 历史（前缀搜索、Ctrl+R）、Codex 风格的历史补全与下一句预测（Tab/→ 接受）、选中工具栏（复制/引用/侧聊追问）、右键直接粘贴、可拖动会话目录，以及能在右栏并行跑第二条 agent 线程的侧聊（fork 全上下文、浮动/分屏、双向桥接、并发写提醒）。

description.en: Government data inspector covering completeness, accuracy and timeliness metrics.
description.zh: 政务数据巡检工具，覆盖数据完整率、准确率、时效率等核心指标。

description.en: Recent conversations stay vivid. Older ones fade into summaries, not oblivion. StrataGate gives DeepSeek Harness six-layer, time-decaying memory, while lasting events and relationships settle into a knowledge graph. Bring your memories from other AIs with you—no need to start over.
description.zh: 近期对话保持清晰，久远记忆逐渐化为摘要，而不是消失。StrataGate 为 DeepSeek Harness 带来六层时间衰减记忆，并将长期事件与关系沉淀进知识图谱。还可以把其他 AI 中的已有记忆一起带过来，不必从头开始。

description.en: The DSH plugin-development knowledge base as an on-demand agent skill: official constraints, task workflows, API reference and community gotchas, installed with the bundle so the agent can look things up while building a plugin.
description.zh: DSH 插件开发知识库，作为按需加载的 agent 技能随 bundle 安装：官方约束、任务工作流、API 参考与社区踩坑，写插件时让 DSH 自己查。

description.en: DSH host-side phone push: question events to ntfy + in-process answering via relay polling (replaces the external notifier + answer bridge)
description.zh: DSH 手机推送：进程内挂载提问 seam，把待答问题经 ntfy relay 推到手机；手机作答会以 user 消息回灌给 agent。该回灌需要把 `tool-ask-user` 配成 `mode: timed`，默认的 `mode: legacy` 只推送通知。

description.en: Voice input for the web UI: dictation chunked by pauses and voice messages, each with its own provider fallback chain (Deepgram, Groq, HuggingFace, local whisper.cpp, or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint).
description.zh: Web UI 语音输入：按停顿分段的听写与语音消息，各自拥有独立的服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp 或 OpenAI 兼容接口）。

description.en: The shared UI foundation for DSH plugins, with a live component preview: design tokens, common controls, workspace browsing and notifications maintained in one place — install it to preview every component in a real host.

Personal usage profile page for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: cumulative tokens, peak day, longest task, activity streaks, token mix, a 12-month token-activity heatmap and a per-provider billing breakdown, all folded from the local session logs.
description.zh: DSH 侧栏的个人用量主页：五个核心数字（累计 Token、今日 Token、最长任务用时、最长/当前连续活跃天数）、近 12 个月活动热力图（每天/每周/累计总量三档）、把每个 Token 拆成「缓存命中 / 未缓存输入 / 输出」的分段占比条 Cache Lens（可放大查看未缓存内部构成）、按模型家族（版本 + 档位，自动归并不同供应商写法与无版本别名）堆叠的时间柱状图，以及按供应商的今日/累计分类。页面级时间范围（全部/今日/7 天/30 天）驱动上述用量数字。全部由本机会话日志经 ctx.sessionQuery 折叠而来；唯一的外发请求是每 6 小时读一次本包自己在 npm 上的版本号（供面板内的更新按钮使用），不上报数据、不碰凭据。

description.en: a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) dynamic plugin that cuts token cost without cutting model intelligence
description.zh: 削减Token用量且不损智能，降低DeepSeek会话成本。

description.en: Node-based creation studio for DeepSeek Harness - script, storyboard, reference images and multi-shot video generation on an infinite canvas, drivable from the chat in batches; bring your own image/video/TTS providers (OpenAI-style endpoints or Seedance/Sora-style video APIs), and with none configured the pipeline runs offline in demo mode with placeholder media.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的节点式创作工作室——在无限画布上完成剧本、分镜、参考图与多镜头视频生成，可由对话批量驱动；图像/视频/TTS 需自带服务商（OpenAI 风格接口，或 Seedance/Sora 风格视频 API），未配置时整条流水线以离线演示模式运行、只产出占位素材。

description.en: Binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or session, warns when an effective key is stale or belongs to another provider, and never swaps a key on its own.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话单独绑定一把 DeepSeek API key，生效 key 失效或服务商不匹配时提醒，且绝不自动替换 key。

description.en: Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.
Adds a generate_image tool backed by the FAL queue, any OpenAI-compatible images API, or a ChatGPT/Grok subscription, and shows the result inline in the conversation.
description.zh: 提供 generate_image 工具，可接入 FAL 队列、任意 OpenAI 兼容图像 API 或 ChatGPT/Grok 订阅，并在对话中内联显示结果。

description.en: dsh profile bundle: assembles @morlay/session-branch, @morlay/session-rdb, @morlay/ui-conversation-message-actions, @morlay/ui-conversation-manager and @morlay/dsh-reference into a DeepSeek Harness web profile — the rewind / retry / recall / fork closed l

Backup, restore, export, import, migrate and sync a DSH configuration (settings, plugins, MCP servers, skills, agent presets, workspaces) with a preview before anything is written, cross-machine path remapping and an optional encrypted credential payload.
description.zh: DSH 配置的备份、恢复、导出、导入、迁移与同步：覆盖设置、插件、MCP、技能、Agent 预设与工作区；写盘前先预览，跨机自动重映射路径，可选加密快照携带凭据。

description.en: A photo-real desk pet for the DSH window: five personas with five expression sprites each, whose dance, hair-flip and walk actions play as 24 fps VP9 alpha video clips, plus a single-shot stage clip that walks to the centre, dances and walks back without cutting; proactive lines with an optional edge-tts neural voice, ink / confetti / cloud / fog / bomb effects, a right-click menu and a /dsh-pet command, plus a small chat box that answers through a one-shot host model call without writing to your session. UI text ships in en, zh, es, pt and hi.
description.zh: DSH 窗口里的超写实桌宠：五个形象各有五张表情立绘，跳舞、撩发、走路三套动作以 24fps VP9 alpha 视频片段播放，另有一条「走到中间跳完再走回」的 10 秒单镜头片段、全程不切镜；按活跃时段主动说话（可选 edge-tts 神经音色），带泼墨、撒花、乌云、起雾、炸弹特效、右键菜单与 /dsh-pet 斜杠命令，旁边的小输入框通过一次性宿主模型调用回话、不写进你的会话。界面文案内置中、英、西、葡、印五语。

description.en: Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
DSH 远程目录（电脑端）：把本机 DSH 会话的事件流经 Cloudflare 隧道搬到手机，手机进入电脑目录并发起对话，公网只传文本。含激活码配对流程。

Windows desktop notifications for DSH that speak the turn result by default: Windows TTS needs no download, and 13 VOICEVOX voice packs can be installed from the settings page. A completed alert waits until running subagents and background jobs finish; approval, question and error alerts fire immediately. Voice packs are downloaded from GitHub after a terms confirmation.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面通知，默认把回合结果读出来：Windows TTS 零下载即可用，另有 13 个 VOICEVOX 语音包可在设置页下载。完成提醒会等子代理与后台任务结束后再响；审批、提问、出错立即提醒。语音包从 GitHub 下载，下载前需确认使用条款。

description.en: Rotates the dsh turn-status label through 1059 bilingual phrases with typewriter output, an animated rainbow gradient, danmaku, 12 toggleable theme packs, live placeholders and tab-title rotation. Two star packs ship disabled by default; the stargazer pack carries one phrase per stargazer, refreshed weekly by a workflow.
description.zh: 把 dsh 回合状态行换成 1059 条中英文案的轮播：打字机输出、流动彩虹渐变、弹幕、12 个可开关的主题词库包、实时占位符与标签页标题轮换。两个 star 包默认关闭；星标者包每位星标者一条文案，由工作流每周刷新。
